summary: Victor H. Mair is a scholar of Sinology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and linguistics. He studied at Dartmouth College, SOAS, and Harvard University. He held posts at Harvard (~1976–1979) and the University of Pennsylvania (Professor, ~1979).
Victor Henry was a scholar in linguistics and Indology. He held academic posts at École Centrale de Lille and the University of Paris (1888).

Victor Turner worked in religious studies and related fields. He studied at University College London (~1938–1949) and the University of Manchester (~1950–1955), and served as chair of the Committee on Social Thought at the University of Chicago (~1968–1977).
Victoria Sujata is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. She completed her PhD at Harvard University, where she studied under Michael Aris.

Vidhusekhara Bhattacharya was an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar. He served at Visva-Bharati University as Pandit/supervisor of collation (attested 1929–1932) and Principal (attested 1944), and retired as Asutosh Professor of Sanskrit at the University of Calcutta (attested 1943).
Vidya Dehejia works in history, archaeology, Indology, and Buddhist studies. She studied at the University of Cambridge (~1965–1968) and held a post at Columbia University (~1982).

Vidya Niwas Mishra was a scholar of linguistics and Indology. He studied at the University of Allahabad (~1943–1947) and Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gorakhpur University (~1958–1960), later serving as Professor of Linguistics at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (~1968–1986).

Vilhelm Thomsen was a scholar of linguistics and Iranian and Central Asian studies. After studying at Randers State School and the University of Copenhagen (~1859–1869), he served as a professor at the University of Copenhagen (~1887–1913).
Vincent Arthur Smith worked in Indology, history, and archaeology. He served in the Indian Civil Service (~1871–1900) and later held a post at the University of Oxford (~1910–1920).

Vincent Breugem specializes in Japanology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Taisho, Hanazono, and Kyoto universities, and at Leiden University under Lucia Dolce. He was a research fellow at Leiden University (attested 2012).

Vincent Eltschinger specializes in Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. He studied at Collège Saint-Michel and the University of Lausanne. He held posts at the Austrian Academy of Sciences, IKGA, University of Vienna (~2003–2015), and EPHE (Professor, ~2015).

Vincent Goossaert works in Sinology, religious studies, and history. He studied under Kristofer Schipper (~1992–1997) and held posts at CNRS (~1998–2012), The Chinese University of Hong Kong, and EPHE as Professor of Daoist History (~2012).
Vincent Lefèvre specializes in history, archaeology, and Indology. He studied at École Nationale des Chartes and Sorbonne Nouvelle University, and has served as a curator at Musée Guimet.

Vincent Tournier works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at Leiden University and EPHE, and completed postdoctoral work under Seishi Karashima in 2008. He held an affiliation with the École française d'Extrême-Orient (attested 2021).
Vincenzo Vergiani specializes in Indology and linguistics. He studied under Raffaele Torella and held a post at the University of Cambridge (~2009).
Vindhyeshwari Prasad Dube was an Indology scholar who held posts at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (attested 1920 and 1939).

Virendra Nath Misra specialized in history, archaeology, and Indology. He studied at Savitribai Phule Pune University (~1958–1961) and served as Director of the Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute (~1993–2000).
Vishwa Nath Pathak was an Indology and history scholar who held posts, including Professor, at Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gorakhpur University (attested 1978 and 1987).
Vishwanath Prasad Varma is an Indology and philosophy scholar. He studied under Dhirendra Mohan Datta, Ganga Nath Bhattacharya, Kalikinkar Datta (~1947–1950), and Joachim Wach (1950).
Vitus Angermeier is an Indology scholar. He studied under Roque Mesquita, Chlodwig H. Werba, and Karin Preisendanz (MA supervisor).
